correctness.rationale: Direct exact algebra: Q is orthogonal; H eigenvalues d,d±sqrt(h²+t²) and SPD when d>w; Ab=dq1+hq2 gives the genuine Krylov basis; all three row pairs have minimum singular values c,pc,0 so the unique E-optimal selector equals both DEIM and Q-DEIM. The exact sketched compression is [[d,h-pt],[h,d]], with characteristic discriminant 4h(h-pt). The defective boundary, nonreal phase, condition-two choice d=3w, and sharp envelope follow by explicit nonnegative-square identity. The exact 3×3 rational witness has SPD spectrum {2,3,4}. Standalone SymPy checker passed; finite tests are not the proof.

originality.rationale: Originality is limited to the joint E-optimal two-row, actual DEIM/Q-DEIM, genuine two-step Krylov, condition-two SPD quantitative phase diagram and sharp fixed-width imaginary envelope. The basic nonreal projection observation is explicitly assigned to Nakatsukasa–Tropp (2021), reinforced by Liu–Liu (2026). Bergermann (2026) defines the deterministic sampler; the inspected full text does not state the combined construction or sharp spectral threshold. Grigori et al (2026) restore true Ritz similarity by altering the algorithm. Equivalent formulations and stronger implications were compared; remaining bibliographic risk is recorded.
residual_risks: Earlier special constructions under terms such as oblique Ritz pollution or optimized interpolation nodes may exist outside the inspected corpus.
General perturbation theory could contain a sharp two-by-two imaginary-part inequality; this would not by itself imply joint E-optimal coordinate selection and exact condition-two Krylov realization.
The claim is not that nonreal eigenvalues of symmetric sketched RR are new; that possibility is established prior work.

value.rationale: The minimum-singular-value of a selected Krylov basis is a motivated deterministic sketch-design objective in the 2026 literature. The result shows its *unique global optimizer*, also obtained by two practical pivoting algorithms, fails to preserve real Ritz eigenvalues even with perfect conditioning up to arbitrarily small embedding defect. The exact parameter frontier and sharp sqrt(defect) spectral-pollution envelope quantify a structural limit and motivate separate symmetry-preserving Ritz treatment. It is not a claim about an arbitrary poor sketch or a mere restatement of known nonreal sRR possibility.
